notes.title: 0.4.0 Update Description
notes.content:
newly added:
1. Add a new role and related tasks.
2. Add an item manufacturing and decomposition system near the computer desk. (Currently a functional experimental version)
3. Add hairstyles and clothing.
4. The landlord's task continues to advance.
5. The "card washing machine" incident now has more options.
6. Added support for English and traditional Chinese characters.
Adjustment:
1. Interface style adjustment.
2. Simplified character body editing.
3. Photography skills can be directly acquired through purchasing skill books.
4. New color related content has been added to the storyline dialogue at the beginning of the game, and some adjustments have been made.
5. The 'System Assistant' will interact more with players and will officially appear as an important character in the future.
6. The task icon can display new task prompts, and the task details can be displayed by folding in the taskbar.
7. Ordinary unlocking requires the consumption of props, which can be made much cheaper by purchasing graphics.
When editing and saving a set, the clothing used will be removed from the inventory, and the clothing items will be returned when the set is updated or disassembled.
9. The character observation interface allows for the selection of observation focus.
other:
I'm really sorry for not updating for so long, mainly because I spent a lot of time and effort adjusting the kernel functions to lay the foundation for expanding more features and gameplay in the future. I have added many supporting features that will gradually be displayed as the plot progresses. Next, I will focus on recommending the story. The previous archive will no longer be applicable to this version. If you want to quickly recover to the previous progress, you can use the S56 and HS2 codes in the support interface to obtain "money" and "stamina". However, I strongly recommend that you do not rely on these to skip the game experience. I will not intentionally increase the value to stop the game progress, hoping to bring a comfortable gaming experience to everyone. If you are willing to provide more support for this game, you can purchase related DLC. Thank you everyone!

notes.title: 0.3.2更新说明
notes.content:
更新类容：
新增：
	1.新增发色编辑。
	2.加入套装编辑功能，可以在“我的房间-电脑”里找到功能入口。
	3.现在可以指定角色穿着编辑好的套装，需要达到套装的需求角色才会同意穿着。在与角色互动时点击“服装”按钮即可。
	4.新增照相功能，获得拍照能力后可以通过拍照赚钱，照片能赚取多少钱就看照片里角色的服和装姿势了，还有清晰度也很重要。有多种照相模式，在出现相机图标时都可以试试。
5.电脑里新增了“e”功能，目前只有注册“摄影师”功能，“上网浏览”目前只是消耗时间没有任何内容。
6.增加了一些服装。
调整：
1.调整了“电脑”界面，现在电脑功能都直接展示在第一层结构里了。
2.现在打招呼时对象会对准摄像机。
修正：
1.修正了一些互动错误。
其他：
这次更新主要是加入了一些互动系统，没有多少剧情类容加入。计划下个更新多加入一些剧情和玩法。
由于数据调整比较多，虽然做了数据兼容的处理尽量保存了数据但还是可能出现NPC消失等情况，出现这种情况只需要点击时间按钮或者直接睡觉过后NPC就会恢复到正确的位置了。如果还有更严重的情况导致无法继续游戏请留言，在正式版本推出前存档会出现不兼容的情况还请大家见谅。如存档损坏没法使用，点击闪电图标输入666即可开启作弊模式可以修改角色能力值。

notes.title: First update
notes.content:
Update Class Content:

New:

1. Add character editing functions: body shape adjustment, hairstyle change. (The color adjustment interface has not been completed yet, so we will not add color editing function this time.)

2. Join the task system and view the ongoing task prompts in the task panel.

3. Add 7 sets of animations. (Not directly displayed in the "Fantasy" function, most of which can be gradually unlocked and seen in new tasks)

4. Add a "Role Editing Room" with the entrance located on the computer in your own room.

Adjustment:

1. Combined with the character editing function, the game's start guidance section has been adjusted.

2. Make significant adjustments to the character model.

3. The vast majority of animations have been modified.

4. All clothing updates. (There will be some adjustments to the clothing in future updates)

5. Redo the unlock game.

6. Changes to the main interface.

7. The sleep options are integrated into one interface.

8. Adjust the exercise interface to select the exercise duration.

9. Adjust the information window during character interaction by adding different colors to distinguish attributes.

10. The interaction with the door has added the "knock" option.

11. Adjusted the over handling when switching objects with the lens.

12. Interactive items will now have highlighted reminders.

13. Adjust the character card UI.

14. Added confirmation prompt for archive loading.

15. Adjust the display format of the main dialog box, with a built-in function for scrolling through the history of this conversation.

Correction:

1. Fixed an error loading an empty archive.

2. Fixed the issue of UI sometimes not triggering correctly.

Other:

Due to significant changes, previous archives may have errors. In order to facilitate everyone to experience the game content as soon as possible, after this update, the cheating code of "666" is still valid and can be continued to be used. If it is activated by clicking the lightning icon, the amount will be directly increased. However, it is still recommended to start from scratch, as the process itself is not long. I don't have any plans to increase the game's duration by repeatedly brushing data, so I can start over with peace of mind.

Due to time constraints, there is still a lot of content that has not been presented. We hope everyone can understand and apologize for waiting so long! It all depends on everyone's help to continue to do so. In the future, major updates will be released with a donation item. I hope everyone can support me a lot! Thank you!
